metadata.title: Cloud Scaffold Product Portal
metadata.description: A concise product portal for the Cloud Scaffold console.

home.heroDescription: A stable foundation for building multi-tenant operations platforms with auth, permissions, storage, and admin workflows.
home.capabilitiesDescription: Start with a focused console, then grow into separate sites, portals, and tenant-facing apps without duplicating the core login flow.

auth.title: Shared Authentication
auth.description: Keep route entry points in each app while centralizing password checks, lock rules, session creation, and MFA branching.

permissions.title: Permission-Aware Pages
permissions.description: Server-side guards and menu access stay close to data boundaries, with client controls reserved for product experience.

storage.title: Storage Workflows
storage.description: S3 upload sessions, private downloads, public images, and attachment records follow the same platform contract.

metadata.title: Sign in - Cloud Scaffold
metadata.description: Sign in from the product portal before choosing a partner workspace.

login.title: Sign in to Cloud Scaffold
login.description: Enter your account first. Partner selection and platform routing will happen after authentication.

form.defaultError: Sign in failed. Please try again.
form.mfaDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.

metadata.title: Select partner - Cloud Scaffold
metadata.description: Choose a partner workspace before entering a platform.

partner.title: Select a partner
partner.description: Welcome, {name}. Choose the partner workspace you want to enter.
partner.defaultError: The partner could not be selected. Please try again.

metadata.title: No active partner - Cloud Scaffold
metadata.description: This account has no active partner workspace.

locked.title: No active partner is available
locked.description: The account was authenticated, but no active partner workspace is available yet.
